snapshot.title: DAA-1 Log File Recovery — Hangar 2

fields.subject: DAA-1 Telemetry Log Recovered — Corrupted File Restored
fields.description: The DAA-1 device at Hangar 2 (192.168.88.40) has been reconnected to the NAS. The previously zero-byte log file (DAA-1-20261015-0900.log) now shows a valid 1.2 MB file. The checksum now matches the manifest in \HUOG-NAS01\ops\link-logs\2026-10-15\manifest.json. The file was corrupted during the firmware update window (08:55–09:00), but the system auto-recovered upon reconnection. No manual intervention was required. The log confirms the GPS-071 alert occurred at 08:58:14 and the aircraft climbed to 420 ft AGL in 6.3 seconds.

activity.author: SCL-03
activity.text: Verified the log file integrity against the manifest. File is valid and timestamps match the incident timeline. No evidence of tampering.

activity.author: Field Technician
activity.text: Automated alert: DAA-1 device at 192.168.88.40 reconnected to NAS and resumed file sync.

snapshot.instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should acknowledge the log recovery but not over-investigate, as it confirms prior findings.
